title: DerivedValue
description: The carve-out for values that are computed rather than quoted (PLAN.md, 'Python-derived values have no span'). ARR/NNT/effect sizes from clinical_math.py, and GRADE modifiers such as an imprecision downgrade read off a confidence interval, exist in no paper as text — a literal-substring rule would reject them. They carry the formula and the locators of their inputs instead, and the check recomputes the arithmetic.

formula.description: Human- and machine-readable statement of the computation, e.g. 'ARR = CER - EER' or 'ci_low < 1 < ci_high'.

inputs.description: Locators for every quoted value the formula consumes.
